fact: Intelwatch says Angola does not run an independent biometric voter registration and its electoral roll is derived from the civil identity database; the 2025 Lei do Recenseamento Eleitoral Oficioso replaces in-person registration with an automatic register extracted from the identity base.

Angola's target architecture lists integration of the criminal record, vehicle registration, commercial registry, land registry and notarial systems with the civil registry and identity card system in the digital identity database; the document does not say they are keyed on the NUC.
Minister Marcy Lopes says the Bilhete de Identidade is the main document for the update of the electoral register (Registo Eleitoral Oficioso) running from 15 June 2026 to 31 March 2027.

Justice Minister Marcy Lopes says the ID database exchanges information with the citizens database to update the electoral register, and is integrated with the Interior Ministry, prison services and migration service.
